candidate_program.name: piecewise_exchange
candidate_program.rationale: Uses direct reward for isolates, exchange margin for single conflicts, and maximum-plus-average penalties for larger neighborhoods. Local count branches provide distinct repair behavior with constant-size arithmetic; missing neighbor compatibility limits the displacement estimate.
candidate_program.rule: weight if degree == 0 else (weight - max_conflict_weight if degree <= 1 else weight - 0.5 * max_conflict_weight - 0.5 * conflict_weight / (1 + degree))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
